title: Best Tools to Turn Microsoft Teams into a Ticketing System
summary: Compare the best tools to turn Microsoft Teams into a ticketing system. Find features, integrations, and solutions to streamline IT support.
body_markdown:
Microsoft Teams is a central workspace for internal operations, but many organizations still require employees to leave the platform to submit support requests. Quick questions in channels can go untracked, leaving IT, HR, and operations teams with less visibility into recurring issues and service performance.


The solution is turning Teams into a structured ticketing system where employees can submit requests without leaving their collaboration platform.


A[Microsoft Teams ticketing tool](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) converts messages into trackable tickets with ownership, routing, SLAs, and reporting while keeping the employee experience conversational.


## **Key Takeaways**


- Internal support teams should prioritize Teams ticketing tools that support conversational intake, automated routing, SLA tracking, knowledge management, and analytics.
- [Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) is the recommended choice for teams that need omnichannel support across Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, and employee portals with purpose-built AI agents for ticket resolution.
- AI capabilities vary significantly across platforms. Some tools only route tickets, while others can automatically resolve common requests by referencing knowledge base content.
- Teams ticketing setups can reduce context-switching for both employees and support staff while maintaining structured workflows behind the scenes.


## **Why Microsoft Teams is the Next Frontier for Ticketing**


Internal support teams spend too much time switching between collaboration tools and separate help desk portals. Employees ask questions in Teams, then get redirected to submit a formal ticket elsewhere. The result is friction that leads to untracked requests, shadow IT, and incomplete service data.


A[help desk integration](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) with Microsoft Teams allows employees to submit requests, receive updates, approve actions, and communicate with support teams directly from the collaboration platform they already use.


This reduces context-switching and improves both employee satisfaction and operational efficiency.


### **The Power of Native Integration**


The distinction between Teams-native and Teams-connected matters more than almost any feature on a comparison chart. Teams-native solutions keep the entire ticket lifecycle inside Teams, while Teams-connected tools use Teams as a notification channel while agents work in a separate portal.


For internal support teams managing[IT requests](https://unthread.io/solutions/it-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) , HR questions, and operational workflows, native integration means faster response times and better adoption from employees who never have to learn a new system.


## **Key Features to Look for in a Microsoft Teams Ticketing Solution**


A strong Teams ticketing tool for internal support should help teams:


- Convert Teams messages, DMs, and channel posts into tickets
- Route requests by topic, team, urgency, or employee context
- Track SLAs and ownership across support queues
- Automate recurring Tier 1 questions
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) from resolved requests
- Connect with HRIS, identity, ITSM, and internal operations tools through relevant[integration capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io)
- Provide[analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) for identifying request trends and automation opportunities


### **Advanced Automation and AI**


Teams ticketing tools with AI capabilities can understand request intent, reference knowledge base articles, and draft accurate responses before human handoff. Some platforms can automatically resolve common requests, while others only route tickets to the appropriate team.

Unthread delivers purpose-built AI agents across both Microsoft Teams and Slack, with documented resolution rates in production enterprise environments. At Lemonade, Unthread automatically resolves[40% of tickets](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance teams.


Unlike vendors that achieve high deflection rates primarily through access request automation, Unthread supports a broader range of internal support use cases. A channel such as #it-help can become a full internal help desk where general questions stay in-channel while sensitive matters move into private workflows.


### **Capabilities for Internal Teams**


- [Agentic AI](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) that executes multi-step workflows, not just knowledge base search
- Omnichannel support across[Microsoft Teams](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) ,[Slack](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) ,[email](https://unthread.io/products/shared-email-inbox?ref=unthread.io) , and[customer portal](https://unthread.io/products/customer-portal?ref=unthread.io)

- [SOC 2 Type II](https://unthread.io/security?ref=unthread.io) compliance and security controls for internal support teams


### **What Teams Should Consider**


Unthread is well suited when Teams or Slack is already a primary employee workspace and internal support teams want to reduce manual triage without adding another place for employees to check.


Teams can evaluate the platform through a[14-day free trial](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) . Published plans start at $75 per agent/month, with a minimum of five seats.


## **2) Desk365**


Desk365 provides Teams-based ticketing through employee and agent bots. Its functionality includes ticket creation, updates, and resolution management.


### **Platform Overview**


Desk365 offers conversational ticketing inside Teams. Agents can view, respond, update, and close tickets without opening an external portal.


### **Capabilities**


- Convert any Teams message into a ticket with full context preservation
- Full agent portal inside Teams via Microsoft Entra ID SSO
- Asset Management with Microsoft Intune sync on Premium plans
- AI Agent and Copilot integration for ticket assistance
- Free tier for up to 3 agents


### **What Teams Should Review**


Desk365 pricing starts at $12/agent/month for Standard, with a free tier for up to 3 agents. The platform focuses on Microsoft Teams ticketing, with additional features available across its pricing tiers.


## **3) Tikit by Cireson**


Tikit is built by Cireson, a Microsoft Premier Partner with over 13 years of ITSM experience. It supports ITIL-aligned workflows for organizations needing structured incident, problem, and change management.


### **Platform Overview**


Tikit provides IT ticketing and workflow automation capabilities for IT teams. Its Power Automate integration supports onboarding, offboarding, and approval workflows.


### **Capabilities**


- Right-click any Teams message to convert it into a ticket
- AI Virtual Agent powered by Azure OpenAI for ticket deflection
- Multi-department ESM with private channels per department
- Microsoft 365 integrations including Entra ID, Intune, and Power BI
- ITIL-aligned workflows with change management modules


### **What Teams Should Review**


Tikit pricing starts at $26/agent/month billed annually. The base tiers include single-channel configurations, while multi-department deployments may require additional plan considerations.


## **4) TeamsWork**


TeamsWork provides ticketing functionality within Microsoft Teams, using an organization-wide pricing model. The platform also supports GDPR and HIPAA compliance requirements.


### **Platform Overview**


TeamsWork offers a pricing structure that is not based on team size. MSPs can manage clients through separate ticketing instances per channel, while regional data residency options address specific compliance requirements.


### **Capabilities**


- Multiple ticketing instances per channel or department
- Ticket management through Microsoft Teams
- Regional data residency options for US, EU, and APAC
- Free plan with 30 tickets per month
- Organization-wide pricing starting at $8.75/month, billed annually


### **What Teams Should Review**


TeamsWork offers Microsoft Teams ticketing capabilities, with additional options for regional data residency and multi-department support.


## **5) Freshservice**


Freshservice is Freshworks' IT service management platform with a ServiceBot for Microsoft Teams that enables ticket creation, updates, and one-click approvals without leaving the collaboration platform.


### **Platform Overview**


Freshservice provides IT service management capabilities covering asset management, service catalogs, and internal service delivery. Its ServiceBot is included across all plans, and the platform offers an interface for managing IT service workflows.


### **Capabilities**


- ServiceBot for Teams on all plans including Starter
- Freddy AI Agent for conversational self-service on Enterprise plans
- Full ITSM suite with incident, problem, change, and asset management
- Per-ticket collaboration channels that import conversations back into Freshservice
- One-click approvals directly from Teams messages


### **What Teams Should Review**


Freshservice pricing starts at $19/agent/month for Starter, with AI features requiring Enterprise plans. Teams wanting primarily conversational intake in Teams should check how much ticket management can stay inside Teams versus the external portal.


## **6) InvGate Service Management**


InvGate Service Management provides ITIL-aligned workflows with a Virtual Service Agent that handles conversational ticket creation through natural language inside Teams.


### **Platform Overview**


InvGate provides IT service management capabilities for organizations using structured ITSM processes. The platform supports service desk operations and workflow automation.


### **Capabilities**


- Virtual Service Agent installs from the Teams App Store
- Agents view, respond, and manage tickets without leaving Teams
- ITIL-aligned incident, change, and SLA management
- Free trial available without credit card
- ESM support for multi-department service delivery


### **What Teams Should Review**


InvGate pricing starts at $24.98/agent/month for Starter, with a 5-agent minimum. The platform combines ITSM process management with Microsoft Teams integration for ticket creation and handling.


## **7) SysAid**


SysAid is a full ITSM platform with over 22 years in the market. The SysAid Copilot AI chatbot integrates into Teams for conversational ticketing with intelligent auto-categorization and routing.


### **Platform Overview**


SysAid serves IT environments that use ticketing alongside asset management. Its functionality includes workflow automation, configurable processes, and organizational knowledge management.


### **Capabilities**


- SysAid Copilot AI chatbot in Teams
- Intelligent auto-categorization and routing via generative AI
- Full ITIL suite with incident, problem, change, and asset management
- Approval workflows inside Teams
- Tight asset management integration


### **What Teams Should Review**


SysAid pricing is approximately $79/user/month for the Help Desk tier based on third-party estimates, with no public pricing available. Implementation requirements vary depending on the organization's ITSM workflows and configuration needs.


## **8) Jira Service Management**


Jira Service Management, together with Atlassian Assist, supports conversational ticketing for teams already using Atlassian tools. The native ChatOps app enables Teams-based request intake connected to JSM workflows.


### **Platform Overview**


This option may be relevant when internal support requests need to connect with existing Jira projects or when the company already uses Atlassian for IT, operations, and knowledge management through Confluence.


### **Capabilities**


- Native Teams integration through Atlassian ChatOps app
- AI virtual agent on Premium and Enterprise plans
- Incident management with on-call scheduling from Teams
- Free tier for up to 3 agents
- Automation capabilities and Atlassian ecosystem integrations


### **What Teams Should Review**


Jira Service Management Standard starts at $20.63/agent/month for 50-agent deployments, with AI features requiring Premium plans. The fit may be clearer when the organization already operates around Jira rather than adopting it only for Teams ticketing.


## **9) HappyFox**


HappyFox provides help desk capabilities across email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and web portals with smart rules for automated channel notifications.


### **Platform Overview**


HappyFox is an option for teams that need both internal support and customer-facing ticketing capabilities. The platform supports condition-based smart rules for routing and escalation.


### **Capabilities**


- Create, respond to, and modify tickets directly from Teams
- Smart rules trigger automated channel notifications
- @mention bot to search knowledge base articles from Teams
- Schedule Teams meetings directly from tickets
- Multi-channel intake across email, chat, and messaging


### **What Teams Should Review**


HappyFox pricing starts at $24/agent/month for Basic, with Teams integration requiring the Team plan or above. The platform supports both internal service management and customer-facing ticketing workflows.


## **10) ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus**


ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus integrates with Microsoft Teams through features such as Kanban-style ticket views and message extensions. These capabilities connect Teams conversations with the platform's ITSM workflows.


### **Platform Overview**


ManageEngine supports Enterprise Service Management workflows across IT, HR, and facilities. Its Microsoft Teams integration includes chatbot-based self-service options for end users.


### **Capabilities**


- Create tickets from any Teams message using message extensions
- Kanban-style ticket view inside Teams
- Navigate multiple service desks from single Teams interface
- Remote session initiation and Teams meetings without leaving tickets
- Both cloud and on-premises deployment options


### **What Teams Should Review**


ManageEngine pricing starts at $13/technician/month for Standard cloud deployment. The platform includes ITSM functionality for incident, asset, and service management, with configuration requirements varying by deployment.


## **11) Halo ITSM**


Halo ITSM provides ITIL-aligned modules covering incident, problem, change, asset, and service catalog management. These functions are available within a single ITSM platform.


### **Platform Overview**


Halo ITSM supports organizations managing multiple IT service processes within one system. The platform provides configuration options through APIs, JSON, and custom fields.


### **Capabilities**


- ITIL modules for incident, problem, change, asset, and service catalog management
- Teams bot with click-to-call functionality
- Configuration through APIs and JSON
- Support for consolidating ITSM processes
- Customer support services


### **What Teams Should Review**


Halo ITSM pricing is approximately $99/agent/month for 30 users plus onboarding fees. Advanced configuration involves SQL, JSON, and API capabilities, depending on the organization's requirements.


## **12) DeskDay**


DeskDay is a conversational service automation platform specifically designed for managed service providers. The IT-Connect Teams app lets MSP end-users raise and track tickets in Teams without separate portals.


### **Platform Overview**


DeskDay provides PSA functionality for managed service providers, including ticket management and communication through Microsoft Teams. The real-time chat syncs between Teams and the PSA for two-way communication.


### **Capabilities**


- IT-Connect Teams app for MSP end users
- Real-time chat synchronization between Teams and PSA
- Helena AI for ticket assistance
- Multi-tenant functionality for managing multiple clients
- Ticket creation through Microsoft Teams


### **What Teams Should Review**


DeskDay pricing starts at $59/tech/month, billed annually. The platform is designed for managed service providers, with functionality focused on multi-client ticket management and PSA workflows.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Can Microsoft Teams fully replace a traditional help desk platform?**


Yes, with the right ticketing solution. Platforms like Unthread extend Microsoft Teams with[structured ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) , AI-driven automation,[workflow management](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , and multi-channel support.


This allows teams to manage requests, track tickets, and resolve issues within their existing communication environment without requiring a separate help desk portal for most workflows. IT, HR, and operations teams can also maintain ticket ownership, monitor SLAs, and automate escalations while keeping employee communication centralized.


### **What are the main benefits of using AI in a Teams ticketing system?**


AI can understand request intent, reference knowledge base articles, draft responses, and automatically resolve common requests.


Unthread demonstrates[40% automatic ticket resolution](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) at Lemonade across multiple internal support teams. This reduces manual triage while escalating complex matters to the right staff.


AI can also identify recurring employee questions and documentation gaps, helping support teams improve their knowledge bases and reduce repetitive workloads over time.


### **How does Unthread handle tickets from multiple channels like email and live chat within Teams?**


Unthread provides omnichannel support that unifies requests from[Microsoft Teams](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) ,[Slack](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) ,[email](https://unthread.io/products/shared-email-inbox?ref=unthread.io) , and[customer portals](https://unthread.io/products/customer-portal?ref=unthread.io) into a single internal help desk. Support teams manage all requests from one place while employees submit requests through their preferred channel.


Each request can be tracked with consistent ticket statuses, assignments, and SLA rules, helping IT, HR, and operations teams coordinate responses across communication channels without losing conversation context.


### **Is it possible to integrate a Microsoft Teams ticketing system with existing CRM or HRIS tools?**


Yes. Most Teams ticketing platforms support[integrations](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io) with common business systems. Unthread connects with Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, Okta, Workday, Rippling, and other enterprise tools through pre-built integrations, webhooks, and flexible APIs.


These connections allow internal support teams to automate workflows such as employee onboarding, access provisioning, and ticket synchronization while reducing manual updates between systems.


### **What kind of analytics and reporting can I expect from a Teams-based help desk solution?**


Teams ticketing tools can provide real-time tracking of support volume, SLA breaches, and recurring issue patterns. Unthread's[AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) measures deflection rates, identifies automation opportunities, and exports data to BI tools like Looker and Tableau for deeper analysis.


Teams can also monitor response and resolution times, evaluate support performance across departments, and identify recurring issues that may benefit from additional automation or updated documentation.
